description: This file contains unit tests for the PatientProgram class within the OpenMRS core API, focusing on methods related to managing patient states within a program, such as voiding the last state and transitioning to new states.

classes.name: PatientProgramTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the functionalities of the PatientProgram class in OpenMRS, covering state voiding and state transition behaviors.

methods.name: voidLastState_shouldVoidStateWithEndDateNullIfStartDatesEqual
methods.description: Verifies that the last state with a null end date is voided correctly when start dates are equal.

methods.name: voidLastState_shouldVoidStateWithEndDateEqualToProgramCompletionDate
methods.description: Verifies that the last state with a null end date is voided correctly when start dates are equal to the program's completion date.

methods.name: transitionToDate_shouldSetEndDateOfNewStateToProgramCompletionDateIfProgramCompleted
methods.description: Checks that the end date of the new state is set to the program's completion date when the program is already completed.

methods.name: transitionToDate_shouldSetEndDateOfNewStateToNullIfProgramNotCompleted
methods.description: Ensures that the end date of a new state is null if the program is not yet completed.

methods.name: getSortedStates_shouldReturnAllStatesEvenIfTwoHaveIdenticalStartAndEndDates
methods.description: Verifies the sorting of patient states, ensuring all states are returned even with identical start and end dates.
